intro: Chili's Grill & Bar is a Tex-Mex casual-dining chain famous for its sizzling fajitas, Big Mouth burgers, baby back ribs and the build-your-own Triple Dipper. The big draw is value: the 3 for Me combo bundles a drink, an appetizer and a full entree starting around $10.99. Below is the full Chili's menu with prices and calories for 2026, organized by category.
quick_answer: Chili's is best known for its 3 for Me combo, which starts at $10.99 and includes a drink, an appetizer and an entree. The signature sizzling fajitas run about $17.59 for chicken and $19.99 for steak, and the Triple Dipper (pick any three appetizers) is $15.99. Big Mouth burgers start around $12.99.
hot_deal: 3 For Me: Chili's signature value deal bundles a drink, a starter and an entree starting at $10.99 — one of the best-value meals in casual dining. The 2 for $25 deal adds an appetizer, two entrees and a dessert for two. Deals vary by location.

faqs.q: What is the 3 for Me deal at Chili's?
faqs.a: 3 for Me is Chili's value combo: a drink, an appetizer and a full entree starting at $10.99. You can upgrade the entree and some premium picks cost a little more.

faqs.q: How much are fajitas at Chili's?
faqs.a: Classic chicken fajitas are about $17.59 and classic steak fajitas about $19.99. The Original Trio (chicken, steak and shrimp) is around $21.99, and Fajitas for 2 is about $39.99.

faqs.q: What is the Triple Dipper at Chili's?
faqs.a: The Triple Dipper lets you pick any three appetizers with dipping sauces for one price, about $15.99. It is Chili's most popular shareable starter.

faqs.q: Does Chili's have baby back ribs?
faqs.a: Yes. A half order of baby back ribs is about $17.99 and a full order about $22.99, with a choice of dry rub, honey-chipotle or house BBQ sauce.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Chili's?
faqs.a: The best known are the sizzling fajitas, the Triple Dipper, the Oldtimer Big Mouth burger, baby back ribs, and the Molten Chocolate Cake.

faqs.q: Does Chili's have a lunch menu?
faqs.a: Yes. Chili's runs weekday lunch specials, with items like the Big Smasher burger, boneless wings and the Santa Fe salad starting around $10.99 to $11.99 until 3 PM.
